shortDescription: Add or remove device from FortiManager.

options.name: adom
options.description: The ADOM the configuration should belong to.

options.name: blind_add
options.description: When adding a device, module will check if it exists, and skip if it does. If enabled, this option will stop the module from checking if it already exists, and blindly add the device.

options.name: device_ip
options.description: The IP of the device being added to FortiManager. Supports both IPv4 and IPv6.

options.name: device_password
options.description: The password of the device being added to FortiManager.

options.name: device_serial
options.description: The serial number of the device being added to FortiManager.

options.name: device_unique_name
options.description: The desired "friendly" name of the device being added to FortiManager.

options.name: device_username
options.description: The username of the device being added to FortiManager.

options.name: mode
options.description: The desired mode of the specified object.
